run_check_data: run the script to visually inspect generated QA data from a JSONL file
inspect_qa_pairs: inspect question-answer pairs with highlighted answers in a document context
view_document_context: view document context with the answer highlighted in bold red color
parse_jsonl_data: parse a JSONL file containing questions, answers, and documents for inspection
browse_data_interactively: browse through QA data line by line with interactive pause between entries
